title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Insurer Allowances: Recovery of Towed-In Vehicles
content:
**Allowance.** For the insurer's direct payment toward a Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown charge, the insurer adds a recovery allowance to its teardown allowance for a vehicle that came in on a network-arranged tow: **60.00 USD** when the tow-in charge billed more miles than the estimate type's tow free radius, **30.00 USD** when it billed no more than that radius, and none when no tow-in charge was ever posted on the booking.

The miles are the tow miles billed on the booking's tow-in charge.

| Estimate type | Tow free radius (miles) |
|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0 |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0 |
| Scheduled Estimate | 0 |
| Mobile Estimate | 0 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 25 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 35 |

**Cases** (hypothetical tow-in charges)

| Estimate type | Tow miles billed | Recovery allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 25.0 (no more than 25) | 30.00 USD |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 25.1 (more than 25) | 60.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 35.0 (no more than 35) | 30.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 42.0 (more than 35) | 60.00 USD |
| Any type, no tow-in charge ever posted | — | none |
